# Adobe Acrobat Services
> Adobe Acrobat Services provides APIs and tools for PDF generation, manipulation, extraction, signing, and document workflows.

Developer documentation covers REST APIs, SDKs, guides, samples, and release information for integrating Adobe document services into applications.

## Getting Started
- [Documentation Home](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/): Main entry point for Acrobat Services developer documentation and product guides.
- [Overview](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/): Introduction to Acrobat Services capabilities, products, and common integration scenarios.
- [Getting Started](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/gettingstarted/): Quickstart steps for creating credentials and making your first API call.
- [Authentication](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/authentication/): Explains credentials, service account setup, and authentication requirements for API access.
- [Postman Collection](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/apis/): Interactive API explorer and entry point for testing Acrobat Services endpoints.

## PDF Services API
- [PDF Services API Overview](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/): Overview of PDF creation, export, OCR, compression, and document transformation APIs.
- [Create PDF](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/create-pdf/): Convert supported source formats into PDF using the PDF Services API.
- [Export PDF](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/export-pdf/): Convert PDF files into Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other formats.
- [Combine Files](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/combine-pdf/): Merge multiple files into a single PDF document.
- [Compress PDF](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/compress-pdf/): Reduce PDF file size while preserving document quality.
- [OCR PDF](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/ocr-pdf/): Make scanned PDFs searchable using optical character recognition.
- [Protect PDF](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/protect-pdf/): Apply password protection and permissions to PDF documents.
- [Split PDF](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/split-pdf/): Divide a PDF into multiple documents by page ranges.

## PDF Extract API
- [Extract API Overview](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-extract-api/): Extract structured text, tables, and document elements from PDF files.
- [Extract PDF](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-extract-api/howtos/extract-api/): Submit extraction jobs and retrieve structured output from PDF documents.
- [Extract Tables](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-extract-api/howtos/extract-tables/): Focus on extracting tabular content from PDFs for downstream processing.
- [Extract Text and Structure](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-extract-api/howtos/extract-text/): Retrieve text, headings, and document structure from PDF files.
- [Extract API Output Format](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-extract-api/howtos/output-format/): Describes JSON output structure and extracted content organization.

## PDF Accessibility Auto-Tag API
- [Auto-Tag API Overview](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-accessibility-autotag-api/): Automatically add accessibility tags to improve PDF usability and compliance.
- [Auto-Tag PDF](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-accessibility-autotag-api/howtos/auto-tag-pdf/): Run auto-tagging jobs to generate tagged PDF documents.
- [Accessibility Concepts](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-accessibility-autotag-api/): Learn how automated tagging supports accessible document workflows.

## Document Generation API
- [Document Generation API Overview](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/document-generation-api/): Generate PDFs and Word documents from templates and JSON data.
- [Create Your First Document](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/document-generation-api/quickstarts/): Quickstart for building template-driven document generation workflows.
- [Authoring Templates](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/document-generation-api/templatetags/): Define template tags and placeholders for dynamic document generation.
- [JSON Data to Document](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/document-generation-api/howtos/): Guides for merging structured data into document templates.
- [Document Generation Samples](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/document-generation-api/code-samples/): Example implementations for common document generation use cases.

## Electronic Seal API
- [Electronic Seal API Overview](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/electronic-seal-api/): Apply organization-backed electronic seals to PDF documents programmatically.
- [Get Started with Electronic Seal](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/electronic-seal-api/gettingstarted/): Setup steps, prerequisites, and first sealing workflow.
- [Seal PDF Documents](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/electronic-seal-api/howtos/): How-to guides for applying electronic seals to PDFs.
- [Electronic Seal API Reference](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/apis/): API explorer for endpoints related to sealing and document workflows.

## SDKs and Samples
- [SDK Documentation](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/sdks/): Entry point for available Acrobat Services SDKs and language support.
- [Java SDK](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/java/): Use the Java SDK to integrate PDF Services operations.
- [Node.js SDK](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/nodejs/): Use the Node.js SDK for server-side document workflows.
- [Python SDK](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/python/): Use the Python SDK for PDF processing and automation tasks.
- [NET SDK](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/pdf-services-api/howtos/dotnet/): Integrate Acrobat Services into .NET applications.
- [Code Samples](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/code-samples/): Sample projects demonstrating common API operations and patterns.
- [GitHub Samples](https://github.com/adobe/pdfservices-api-documentation-samples): Official sample repository for Acrobat Services documentation examples.

## API Reference
- [API Reference Home](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/apis/): Interactive reference for Acrobat Services REST APIs and operations.
- [PDF Services API Reference](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/apis/#tag/PDF-Services): Endpoint reference for PDF creation and transformation operations.
- [Extract API Reference](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/apis/#tag/Extract-PDF): Endpoint reference for structured PDF extraction operations.
- [Document Generation API Reference](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/apis/#tag/Document-Generation): Endpoint reference for template-based document generation.
- [Electronic Seal API Reference](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/apis/#tag/Electronic-Seal): Endpoint reference for electronic seal workflows.

- [Use Cases](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/): Product documentation organized around practical document workflow scenarios.

## Release Notes and Support
- [Release Notes](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/docs/overview/releasenotes/): Product updates, feature changes, and release history for Acrobat Services.
- [FAQ](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/faq/): Answers to common questions about setup, quotas, and product capabilities.
- [Support](https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/support/): Support resources, issue reporting, and help channels for developers.
